contexts.text: If the Sun appeared... in the zenith...
The Sun... stands constantly midway between the zenith and the horizon. TCR 29:2.
Man... can raise his face to the zenith.
In the zenith... is the seat of one who calls himself Abraham.
That a star in the zenith fell with the rest. Explained.
On the dragon, who has taken his seat in the top or zenith of Heaven.
On hidden Spirits who are in the zenith.
On the more subtle evil Spirits in the line of the zenith at various altitudes.
On those who are high up in the zenith.
a. Some look up to a certain one over head, in the zenith... whom they say is the Father.
